an10.33:1.1: katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannitabboti.
an10.33:1.2: dasahi kho upāli dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannitabbo
an10.33:1.4: idhupāli bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an10.33:1.5: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an10.33:1.6: ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni supavattāni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso
an10.33:1.7: vinaye kho pana ṭhito hoti asaṃhiro
an10.33:1.8: paṭibalo hoti ubho atthapaccatthike saññāpetuṃ nijjhāpetuṃ pekkhātuṃ pasādetuṃ
an10.33:1.14: imehi kho upāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannitabboti.
